Check that the dismantled components are not damaged.

Clean the dismantled components thoroughly.

The alternators are fitted with condensers with long life batteries.

Whilst washing the alternator components, it is possible that immersion in the washing fluid may give rise to a discharge from the condenser with the possible ignition of flammable liquids.
